chogath.notes:
- passive (Carnivore): Killing units restores Health and Mana, scaling with level
- Q (Rupture): Knockup and slow at target location dealing damage
- W (Feral Scream): Cone magic damage and silence enemies for duration
- E (Vorpal Spikes): Auto-attacks release spikes, damaging and slowing enemies forward
- R (Feast): True damage devour; killing grows Cho'Gath permanently, gaining Health
- spike: Level 6 with Feast; three-item tanky builds become unkillable
- tip: Stay outside Rupture range and group to prevent Feast picks

irelia.notes:
- passive (Ionian Fervor): Stacking attack speed on spell hits; max stacks grant bonus on-hit damage
- Q (Bladesurge): Dash forward striking target, heal self; cooldown refreshes if target Marked or dies
- W (Defiant Dance): Charge strike for scaling damage; reduced physical damage taken while charging
- E (Flawless Duet): Two blades converge damaging, stunning, and Marking enemies caught between
- R (Vanguard's Edge): Fire blades exploding on champion hit, dealing damage and Marking; blades form slowing wall
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; triforce-adjacent items unlock sustained damage
- tip: Respect E stun range; kite sideways to avoid both blade convergence and wall

teemo.notes:
- Passive (Guerrilla Warfare): Stand still to go invisible indefinitely, moveable in brush.
- Q (Blinding Dart): Damage and blind enemy vision for duration.
- W (Move Quick): Passive movespeed, sprint for bonus movespeed unpurgeable briefly.
- E (Toxic Shot): On-hit poison damage over 4 seconds per attack.
- R (Noxious Trap): Place mushroom trap slowing and damaging enemies stepping on.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and early magic penetration items.
- tip: Sweep for traps and avoid brush where invisible.

nautilus.notes:
- passive (Staggering Blow): First attack on target roots briefly, deals bonus physical damage
- Q (Dredge Line): Anchor pulls enemy and Nautilus together or pulls Nautilus to terrain
- W (Titan's Wrath): Temporary shield; empowered attacks deal damage over time to target and nearby
- E (Riptide): Three waves around self damage and slow enemies in area
- R (Depth Charge): Shockwave chases enemy, knocks airborne enemies it passes through upward
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; tank items and Hollow Radiance spike survivability
- tip: Maintain distance from terrain to prevent Dredge Line anchor catches

mordekaiser.notes:
- Passive (Darkness Rise): Stacks 3 times; grants damage aura and movement speed.
- Q (Obliterate): Smashes ground dealing damage; increased versus single target.
- W (Indestructible): Converts dealt and taken damage into shield; consume to heal.
- E (Death's Grasp): Pulls all enemies in target area toward him.
- R (Realm of Death): Isolates enemy, steals stats; permanent if kill before respawn.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate enables 1v1 isolation; armor/health items spike power.
- tip: Maintain distance; never fight alone; build grievous wounds and magic resist.

alistar.notes:
- passive (Triumphant Roar): Charges from CC or nearby enemy deaths; heals when full
- Q (Pulverize): Smash ground, damage and airborne nearby enemies
- W (Headbutt): Headbutt target, damage and knockback
- E (Trample): Trample nearby enemies, stun next auto at max stacks
- R (Unbreakable Will): Remove CC, reduce all damage briefly
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; early tankiness items
- tip: Stay spaced apart to avoid Pulverize and Trample combo

akshan.notes:
- passive (Dirty Fighting): Every third hit deals bonus damage and grants shield versus champions.
- Q (Avengerang): Boomerang deals damage outward and returning, extending range with each enemy hit.
- W (Going Rogue): Mark enemy killers as Scoundrels; kill them to revive allies and gain gold.
- E (Heroic Swing): Grapple terrain and swing, firing at nearest enemy; exit early or on collision.
- R (Comeuppance): Lock onto champion, store bullets, fire for missing health damage on hit.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; critical item spike with attack speed and crit.
- tip: Deny grapple points and punish his immobility before E resets.

ahri.notes:
- Passive (Essence Theft): Kill 9 minions/monsters to heal; champion kills heal more
- Q (Orb of Deception): Send orb out dealing magic damage, return deals true damage
- W (Fox-Fire): Gain movespeed burst, release three homing foxfires at nearby enemies
- E (Charm): Blow kiss stopping dashes, charm target into walking toward you
- R (Spirit Rush): Dash forward firing bolts; three recasts, refreshed per champion takedown
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; midgame with ability haste and pen items
- tip: Stay behind minions to block Charm; position away from walls she controls

aatrox.notes:
- passive (Deathbringer Stance): Bonus magic damage and healing on next basic attack, scales with target max health
- Q (The Darkin Blade): Slam greatsword three times with different area damage patterns, repositioning between swings
- W (Infernal Chains): Damage first enemy hit; champions/large monsters dragged to center if they stay
- E (Umbral Dash): Heal when damaging champions passively; active dash in chosen direction for repositioning
- R (World Ender): Fear minions, gain attack damage and move speed; extend duration on takedowns
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; major spike at Bruiser items granting attack damage
- tip: Stay outside W impact zone and space away from his dash engage range

amumu.notes:
- passive (Cursed Touch): Basic attacks curse enemies, amplifying magic damage taken
- Q (Bandage Toss): Stun and damage target, pull yourself to them
- W (Despair): Nearby enemies lose max health per second, refresh curses
- E (Tantrum): Reduce physical damage taken permanently, unleash rage damaging nearby
- R (Curse of the Sad Mummy): Stun all nearby enemies, apply curse, damage
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; mid-game tank items grant durability spike
- tip: Spread out to minimize Despair and ultimate damage effectiveness

anivia.notes:
- Passive (Rebirth): Fatal damage converts to egg form, reviving with full health once.
- Q (Flash Frost): Ice sphere travels, damages and chills enemies, explodes for stun.
- W (Crystallize): Creates temporary impassable ice wall blocking all movement briefly.
- E (Frostbite): Wind blast damage doubled if target hit by Q or R.
- R (Glacial Storm): Persistent ice rain damages and slows enemies in area.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; completed mana items spike mid-game damage.
- tip: Space away from her to avoid Q engage and W trap.

aphelios.notes:
- passive (The Hitman and the Seer): Wield two of five Lunari weapons; swap when main-hand empties
- Q (Weapon Abilities): Activate unique ability based on main-hand weapon; consumes ammo
- W (Phase): Swap main-hand and off-hand weapons, changing attacks and Q ability
- E (Weapon Queue System): Display next weapon Alune provides; rotates when current weapon depletes
- R (Moonlight Vigil): Fire moonlight blast at enemies; applies main-hand weapon effect on hit
- spike: Early crit items and level 6 ultimate availability spike damage
- tip: Stay outside effective weapon ranges; abuse his long Q cooldown windows

aurora.notes:
- Passive (Spirit Abjuration): Exorcised spirits from damaged enemies heal Aurora passively
- Q (Twofold Hex): Curse enemies, recast to pull curses back damaging foes
- W (Across the Veil): Leap, become invisible, gain movespeed briefly in spirit realm
- E (The Weirding): Blast damages and slows enemies, Aurora hops backward safely
- R (Between Worlds): Leap with shockwave, create slowzone with teleport between edges
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and mid-game spirit item power spikes
- tip: Keep distance and use hard CC to catch her rotating

azir.notes:
- passive (Shurima's Legacy): summon Disc of the Sun from destroyed turrets for mobility
- Q (Conquering Sands): send soldiers forward dealing magic damage and slowing enemies hit
- W (Arise!): summon soldier replacing basic attacks, dealing magic damage in line
- E (Shifting Sands): dash to soldier, shield self, damage enemies, spawn soldier on champion hit
- R (Emperor's Divide): wall of soldiers charges forward knocking back and damaging
- spike: mid-game with attack speed items and level 6 ultimate
- tip: stay outside soldier attack range and punish long cooldown windows

bard.notes:
- passive (Traveler's Call): Meeps assist attacks; at max chimes, meeps slow and deal area damage
- Q (Cosmic Binding): Missile slows first enemy, stuns if hits wall or second enemy
- W (Caretaker's Shrine): Shrine heals and speeds up first ally that touches it
- E (Magical Journey): Portal through terrain; allies and enemies can traverse one-way
- R (Tempered Fate): Stasis all units hit in target area briefly
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; core items spike damage and utility significantly
- tip: Respect portal positioning; play around stasis by grouping defensively

brand.notes:
- passive (Blaze): Spells apply DoT stacking to 3; max stack destabilizes champion/large monster
- Q (Sear): Fire ball deals damage; stuns if target ablaze
- W (Pillar of Flame): Delayed AoE damage; 25% bonus to ablaze targets
- E (Conflagration): Blast spreads to nearby enemies; doubled spread if target ablaze
- R (Pyroclasm): Fire bounces up to 5 times, prioritizes stacking Blaze on champions
- spike: Level 6 when ultimate provides chain teamfight damage
- tip: Spread out to minimize Conflagration spread and Pyroclasm bounces

braum.notes:
- passive (Concussive Blows): Stacks on attacks; 4 stacks stun and deal magic damage
- Q (Winter's Bite): Slow projectile from shield, applies one Concussive Blow stack
- W (Stand Behind Me): Leap to ally, grant armor and magic resist briefly
- E (Unbreakable): Raise shield to block and destroy all incoming projectiles
- R (Glacial Fissure): Knockup nearby enemies and line ahead, leave slowing fissure
- spike: Early game with support items; scaling with armor/magic resist
- tip: Stay behind minions to avoid Q; spread out against R

camille.notes:
- passive (Adaptive Defenses): Grants shields matching damage type of champion basic attacks
- Q (Precision Protocol): Next attack bonus damage and speed, recast deals more if delayed
- W (Tactical Sweep): Cone blast slows outer enemies, deals extra damage, heals Camille
- E (Hookshot): Leap to wall, knock up enemies upon landing
- R (The Hextech Ultimatum): Dash to champion, anchor them, bonus magic damage on attacks
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; item spike with armor penetration
- tip: Maintain distance; position away from walls to deny Hookshot engage angles

caitlyn.notes:
- Passive (Headshot): Bonus damage every few attacks; doubled range on trapped/netted enemies
- Q (Piltover Peacemaker): Penetrating shot dealing physical damage, reduced on subsequent targets
- W (Yordle Snap Trap): Trap immobilizes enemy for 1.5s, grants empowered Headshot
- E (90 Caliber Net): Slow on target; knockback recoil pushes Caitlyn away
- R (Ace in the Hole): Long-range massive damage shot; enemies can intercept for ally
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and critical strike items dramatically increase damage
- tip: Stay behind minions to block Piltover Peacemaker and intercept Ace in the Hole

corki.notes:
- passive (Hextech Munitions): Percentage of basic attack damage converts to bonus true damage
- Q (Phosphorus Bomb): Deals magic damage in area and reveals enemies briefly
- W (Valkyrie): Flies short distance, leaves damaging fire trail behind movement
- E (Gatling Gun): Rapid cone damage reducing both armor and magic resist
- R (Missile Barrage): Fires missile dealing area damage; every third is stronger
- spike: Level 6 unlocks ultimate; Liandry's or Manamune significantly increases damage
- tip: Maintain distance from fire trails and dodge predictable missile patterns

drmundo.notes:
- passive (Goes Where He Pleases): Resists first immobilize, loses health, drops recoverable canister nearby
- Q (Infected Bonesaw): Throws bonesaw dealing current health damage and slow to first enemy
- W (Heart Zapper): Electrocutes self, damages nearby enemies, stores damage taken, bursts on recast
- E (Blunt Force Trauma): Gains bonus AD scaling with max health; active slams for missing health damage
- R (Maximum Dosage): Heals missing health instantly, gains movespeed and sustained health regeneration
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; late game with health stacking items
- tip: Stay at maximum range to avoid Q and E engage combo

draven.notes:
- passive (League of Draven): Catch axes or kill minions for Adoration stacks; bonus gold on champion kills.
- Q (Spinning Axe): Next attack deals bonus damage; axe ricochets back. Can hold two axes.
- W (Blood Rush): Gain move and attack speed; catching axes refreshes cooldown.
- E (Stand Aside): Throw axes dealing damage, knocking enemies aside and slowing them.
- R (Whirling Death): Hurl two axes that reverse after hitting enemy champion and return.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate available; major spike with attack speed items.
- tip: Respect his axe catch range and deny him side lane positioning.

ekko.notes:
- Passive (Z-Drive Resonance): Every third attack/spell grants speed burst on champions
- Q (Timewinder): Throw grenade that slows, damages, then returns to you
- W (Parallel Convergence): Bonus damage to low health; create slow field anomaly
- E (Phase Dive): Roll, gain bonus damage next attack, teleport to target
- R (Chronobreak): Rewind to safer position seconds ago, heal damage taken
- Spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with ability haste items
- Tip: Maintain distance to avoid Phase Dive teleport engagement range

elise.notes:
- passive (Spider Queen): Hitting enemies grants dormant Spiderling; transform to use them.
- Q (Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite): Human deals % max HP; Spider deals % missing HP.
- W (Volatile Spiderling / Skittering Frenzy): Human sends exploding spider; Spider grants attack speed.
- E (Cocoon / Rappel): Human stuns and reveals; Spider dives with Spiderlings.
- R (Spider Form): Transform for speed, melee range, new abilities, Spiderling swarm.
- spike: Level 6 when unlocking Spider Form; early jungle gank pressure.
- tip: Stay grouped and position away from isolated targets in jungle.

ezreal.notes:
- passive (Rising Spell Force): Gains Attack Speed per spell hit, max 5 stacks.
- Q (Mystic Shot): Fires bolt, reduces all cooldowns on enemy hit.
- W (Essence Flux): Orb sticks to champion/objective, detonates for damage on hit.
- E (Arcane Shift): Teleport nearby, fires homing bolt, prioritizes Essence Flux targets.
- R (Trueshot Barrage): Massive energy barrage through units, reduced damage on minions.
- spike: Trinity Force or similar sheen item completes core damage pattern.
- tip: Stay behind minions to avoid free Mystic Shot cooldown resets.

galio.notes:
- passive (Colossal Smash): Bonus magic damage on next basic attack, resets every few seconds
- Q (Winds of War): Fire windblasts that converge into tornado dealing damage over time
- W (Shield of Durand): Charge defensive stance, release to taunt and damage nearby enemies
- E (Justice Punch): Step back and charge, knock up first enemy champion hit
- R (Hero's Entrance): Land on ally, shield nearby allies, knock up enemies on impact
- spike: Level 6 when ultimate available; mid-game with ability power items
- tip: Spread out to reduce damage from W and R knock-ups

fiora.notes:
- passive (Duelist's Dance): Hit revealed Vitals to heal and gain movespeed
- Q (Lunge): Dash and stab nearby enemy, applying on-hit effects
- W (Riposte): Block all damage/CC, stun if blocking immobilize, slow stab
- E (Bladework): Two enhanced attacks: first slows, second critically strikes
- R (Grand Challenge): Reveal all four Vitals, gain movespeed near target
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate, Trinity Force for sustained dueling
- tip: Respect her all-in range and avoid predictable positioning patterns

fiddlesticks.notes:
- Passive (Harmless Scarecrow): Trinket slot replaced with scarecrow effigies for vision control.
- Q (Terrify): Fear enemies when casting spells unseen or targeting with activation.
- W (Bountiful Harvest): Drain nearby enemies; bonus execute damage at drain end.
- E (Reap): Slash area, slow all hit, silence center hit enemies.
- R (Crowstorm): Crows swarm around Fiddlesticks, damaging all nearby enemies continuously.
- spike: Level six ultimate enables devastating teamfight crowd control and damage.
- tip: Ward jungle entrances and stay grouped to prevent surprise Crowstorm.

gangplank.notes:
- Passive (Trial by Fire): Melee strikes ignite enemies periodically for damage over time.
- Q (Parrrley): Shoot target enemy, gain gold if unit dies from it.
- W (Remove Scurvy): Consume citrus to cleanse crowd control and heal yourself.
- E (Powder Keg): Place keg at location; attack it to detonate nearby enemies.
- R (Cannon Barrage): Call ship bombardment on area, slowing and damaging enemies.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; significant power spike with critical strike items.
- tip: Avoid grouping; dodge Cannon Barrage by spreading out and moving unpredictably.

gragas.notes:
- Passive (Happy Hour): Periodically heals when using abilities
- Q (Barrel Roll): Roll cask, explode on command or timer, slows enemies
- W (Drunken Rage): Gain damage and damage reduction after channeling briefly
- E (Body Slam): Charge to location, stun and damage nearby enemies
- R (Explosive Cask): Hurl cask dealing damage and knocking back enemies
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with tankiness items
- tip: Keep distance from walls and tight corridors he controls

graves.notes:
- passive (New Destiny): Shotgun fires 4 bullets; reload when ammo depletes, bullets block on units
- Q (End of the Line): Explosive shell detonates after 1 second or terrain collision
- W (Smoke Screen): Smoke cloud reduces vision; initial impact deals magic damage and slows
- E (Quickdraw): Dash forward gaining resistances; toward champions grants two True Grit stacks instead
- R (Collateral Damage): Shell hits first champion then explodes in cone dealing heavy damage
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; early armor/magic resist items amplify tankiness
- tip: Maintain distance; avoid tight corridors where his bullets cannot pass through

gwen.notes:
- passive (A Thousand Cuts): bonus magic damage scales with target health, heals on champion damage
- Q (Snip Snip!): cone attack up to 6 times, center deals true damage
- W (Hallowed Mist): untargetable outside mist, enemies must enter to damage her
- E (Skip 'n Slash): dash granting attack speed, range, magic damage; cooldown refunded on hit
- R (Needlework): three-cast needle ability slowing and applying passive to champions hit
- spike: level 6 ultimate and Nashor's Tooth powerspike extremely threatening
- tip: stay outside Hallowed Mist and kite; prevent her mist placement advantage

gnar.notes:
- Passive (Rage Gene): Generates Rage in combat; transforms to Mega Gnar at max Rage with new abilities.
- Q (Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss): Throws boomerang that damages, slows, returns; catching reduces cooldown.
- W (Hyper / Wallop): Bonus damage and Move Speed on attacks/spells; Mega stuns area in front.
- E (Hop / Crunch): Leap with bounce off units for distance; Mega crashes for area damage.
- R (GNAR!): Mega throws nearby enemies in direction; wall hits stun and bonus damage.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game teamfight dominance with Rage management.
- tip: Kite away before his Rage maxes and deny walls for his ultimate.

heimerdinger.notes:
- passive (Hextech Affinity): gain move speed near allied towers and turrets
- Q (H-28 G Evolution Turret): place rapid-fire cannon turret with secondary beam attack
- W (Hextech Micro-Rockets): fire long-range rockets converging on cursor location
- E (CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade): lob grenade dealing damage, stunning direct hits, slowing nearby
- R (UPGRADE!!!): enhance next spell for increased effects and power
- spike: level 6 with upgraded turrets; mana item completion
- tip: stay out of turret range; destroy turrets when possible

hecarim.notes:
- passive (Warpath): Gains AD equal to percentage of bonus Move Speed
- Q (Rampage): Cleave nearby enemies; hitting resets cooldown and increases damage
- W (Spirit of Dread): Gain Armor/MR; deal magic damage and heal from nearby enemies
- E (Devastating Charge): Gain MS, charge through units, knockback scales with distance
- R (Onslaught of Shadows): Charge forward dealing magic damage, fear nearby enemies
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; MS item completion (boots, tank items)
- tip: Kite away from him; position near walls to block charge

illaoi.notes:
- Passive (Prophet of an Elder God): Tentacles spawn on terrain, swing at spirits and Harsh Lesson victims.
- Q (Tentacle Smash): Increases tentacle damage; smashes tentacle dealing physical damage.
- W (Harsh Lesson): Leap to target, damage them, tentacles swing at target.
- E (Test of Spirit): Rip spirit out, it takes damage echoed to original target.
- R (Leap of Faith): Smash idol, damage nearby enemies, spawn tentacle per champion hit.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate spawns multiple tentacles; Lifestealing bruiser items amplify dueling.
- tip: Stay away from terrain walls; dodge E spirit pull; kite away from tentacles.

janna.notes:
- passive (Tailwind): Allies gain movespeed toward Janna; bonus movespeed converts to magic damage.
- Q (Howling Gale): Storm grows over time; reactivate to release and knock up enemies.
- W (Zephyr): Passive movespeed and unit-phasing; active deals damage and slows enemy movespeed.
- E (Eye Of The Storm): Shield ally champion or turret; grant them bonus attack damage.
- R (Monsoon): Knockback enemies around Janna; heal nearby allies while active afterward.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; accelerates with utility item purchases.
- tip: Spread formation denies Tailwind value; target Janna before engaging her team.

jarvaniv.notes:
- passive (Martial Cadence): First basic attack deals bonus damage based on enemy current health
- Q (Dragon Strike): Extends lance, damages and reduces armor, pulls Jarvan to flag and knocks up
- W (Golden Aegis): Shields Jarvan and slows nearby enemies
- E (Demacian Standard): Grants passive attack speed; active places flag for magic damage and ally attack speed
- R (Cataclysm): Leaps to target, damages nearby enemies, creates terrain arena around them
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with armor penetration items
- tip: Stay away from his flag to avoid Q-E knockup combo chain

jayce.notes:
- passive (Hextech Capacitor): Gain Move Speed when swapping weapon stances
- Q (To the Skies! / Shock Blast): Leap or fire projectile dealing damage and effects
- W (Lightning Field / Hyper Charge): Mana restore or Attack Speed burst per stance
- E (Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate): Knockback or speed gate depending on weapon form
- R (Mercury Cannon / Mercury Hammer): Transform weapons; first attack reduces target resistances
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; Armor penetration items amplify damage
- tip: Respect Cannon Stance range; dodge Shock Blast; stay grouped against gates

jhin.notes:
- Passive (Whisper): Four shots then reload; fourth shot critically strikes with execute bonus damage.
- Q (Dancing Grenade): Bounces to four targets, gains damage per kill, resets on elimination.
- W (Deadly Flourish): Long-range piercing shot through minions, stops on first champion hit.
- E (Captive Audience): Invisible trap slows and damages enemies in explosion radius when triggered.
- R (Curtain Call): Four long-range piercing shots; stops on first champion per shot.
- spike: Level six with ultimate; critical strike chance and lethality items amplify threat.
- tip: Stay behind minions to block W and R shots; dodge predictable trap placements.

kaisa.notes:
- passive (Second Skin): stacks Plasma on attacks; bonus magic damage scales with stacks
- Q (Icathian Rain): shoots seeking missiles at nearby targets; upgraded to more missiles
- W (Void Seeker): long-range missile marks enemies with passive; upgraded cooldown reduction on hit
- E (Supercharge): grants movement speed then attack speed; upgraded grants brief invisibility
- R (Killer Instinct): dashes near enemy champion for close engagement
- spike: level 6 with ultimate; stronger with attack speed and on-hit items
- tip: maintain distance; dodge W missile; group to prevent isolated target elimination

katarina.notes:
- Passive (Voracity): Enemy champion death resets cooldowns; picking up Dagger slashes nearby enemies
- Q (Bouncing Blade): Throw Dagger bouncing between enemies, lands on ground
- W (Preparation): Gain movement speed burst, toss Dagger above yourself
- E (Shunpo): Blink to target, strike enemy or nearest foe
- R (Death Lotus): Channel massive magic damage on 3 nearest enemies
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; Liandry's/Zhonyas completion
- tip: Respect Dagger positioning; stand away from teammates; buy grievous wounds early

kayn.notes:
- Passive (The Darkin Scythe): Heal from spell damage; transform into Darkin or Shadow Assassin
- Q (Reaping Slash): Dash then slash enemies for damage in area
- W (Blade's Reach): Damage and slow enemies in line skillshot
- E (Shadow Step): Walk through terrain and walls freely
- R (Umbral Trespass): Hide in enemy, burst out dealing massive damage
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with ability haste items
- tip: Stay grouped and buy control wards to deny flanks

kennen.notes:
- passive (Mark of the Storm): Stuns enemies after 3 marks applied via abilities
- Q (Thundering Shuriken): Throws shuriken dealing damage and applying one mark
- W (Electrical Surge): Passive extra damage every few attacks plus mark; active damages marked enemies
- E (Lightning Rush): Dashes through units applying mark, grants move speed entering and attack speed leaving
- R (Slicing Maelstrom): Strikes nearby enemy champions repeatedly with magical damage
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; early armor/magic resist items
- tip: Spread out to minimize his ultimate's multi-target damage potential

khazix.notes:
- passive (Unseen Threat): marks isolated enemies; abilities trigger special interactions
- Q (Taste Their Fear): increased damage on isolated targets; cooldown refund if evolved
- W (Void Spike): damages enemies; heals Kha'Zix if in explosion radius
- E (Leap): damages on landing; resets on kill/assist if wings evolved
- R (Void Assault): grants one ability evolution per rank; invisibility and speed boost
- spike: level 6 with first evolution; early lethality items spike damage
- tip: group with allies to deny isolation; buy defensive items early

kindred.notes:
- passive (Mark of the Kindred): Mark targets to Hunt; completing Hunts permanently empowers abilities and increases attack range every 4 Hunts
- Q (Dance of Arrows): Tumble and shoot up to three arrows at nearby enemies
- W (Wolf's Frenzy): Wolf attacks nearby enemies; Lamb gains stacks from moving/attacking, restores health when fully charged
- E (Mounting Dread): Slow target; third attack after two more hits causes Wolf to pounce for massive damage
- R (Lamb's Respite): Zone prevents all deaths inside until effect ends, then heals units
- spike: Early game with completed Hunts; mid-game with attack speed items
- tip: Group with allies to deny isolated Hunts and protect vulnerable teammates from pounce

kogmaw.notes:
- passive (Icathian Surprise): explodes four seconds after death, deals true damage nearby
- Q (Caustic Spittle): launches projectile dealing magic damage, reduces armor/magic resist, grants attack speed
- W (Bio-Arcane Barrage): attacks gain range and deal percent maximum health magic damage
- E (Void Ooze): launches ooze damaging enemies, leaves slowing trail behind
- R (Living Artillery): fires distant shell dealing magic damage, more damage to low health
- spike: level six with ultimate; two-item attack speed spike dangerous
- tip: stay outside maximum attack range or behind heavy frontline units

kled.notes:
- passive (Skaarl, the Cowardly Lizard): Kled rides Skaarl who absorbs damage; dismounted when depleted
- Q (Bear Trap on a Rope): Throws trap damaging champion, yanks toward Kled if shackled
- W (Violent Tendencies): Grants attack speed for four attacks; fourth deals bonus damage
- E (Jousting): Dash dealing damage with speed boost; recast dashes back through target
- R (Chaaaaaaaarge!!!): Charges location with trail, shield, and rams first enemy champion encountered
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and trinity force completion threaten all-in engagement
- tip: Maintain distance and dodge Bear Trap to prevent being yanked into danger

leblanc.notes:
- passive (Mirror Image): Invisibility and clone spawn below 40% health; lasts 8 seconds
- Q (Sigil of Malice): Mark target; ability hit detonates for bonus damage
- W (Distortion): Dash and damage; reactivate within 4 seconds to return
- E (Ethereal Chains): Chain shackles; 1.5 second root and damage if held
- R (Mimic): Cast mimicked version of Q, W, or E
- spike: Level 6 with Mimic; three-item power spike mid-game
- tip: Maintain distance and watch for W activation to dodge chains

leesin.notes:
- Passive (Flurry): Next 2 attacks gain attack speed and restore energy after abilities.
- Q (Sonic Wave / Resonating Strike): Project wave dealing damage; follow with dash if hit.
- W (Safeguard / Iron Will): Rush ally for shield; shield self and champion ally.
- E (Tempest / Cripple): Shockwave reveals enemies; cast slow if it connects.
- R (Dragon's Rage): Kick target away, damaging enemies they collide with.
- Spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with crit items.
- Tip: Ward river; avoid predictable positioning when his Q comes off cooldown.

lillia.notes:
- passive (Dream-Laden Bough): Spells deal max Health damage over time to champions/monsters
- Q (Blooming Blows): Gain stacking Move Speed per spell hit; activate for magic damage
- W (Watch Out! Eep!): Deal area damage, extra heavy damage in center
- E (Swirlseed): Hurl seed dealing damage and slow; rolls until wall/target
- R (Lilting Lullaby): Sleep enemies with Dream Dust, extra damage when woken forcibly
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; three-item power spike with movement speed
- tip: Stay grouped and interrupt sleep chain before Lillia engages teamfights

locke.notes:
- passive (Silver Stake): bonus magic damage on-hit, scales with enemy missing health
- Q (Ritual Nails): throw nails dealing damage, mark enemies, consume marks for bonus damage
- W (Soul Ignition): gain attack and move speed, take damage, heal portion back later
- E (Ashen Pursuit): teleport then dash-attack next target, damage enemies on path
- R (Purgatory): throw artifact dealing damage, execute low health enemies, gain power per champion
- spike: level 6 ultimate unlocked and early on-hit item completion
- tip: stay grouped and maintain distance to avoid his dash-attack chain execution

lissandra.notes:
- Passive (Iceborn Subjugation): Slain enemies near Lissandra become Frozen Thralls, slowing and damaging nearby foes.
- Q (Ice Shard): Throws ice spear that shatters, damaging and slowing enemies hit.
- W (Ring of Frost): Freezes nearby enemies, dealing magic damage and rooting them in place.
- E (Glacial Path): Creates ice claw dealing damage; reactivate to teleport to claw location.
- R (Frozen Tomb): Stuns enemy champion or heals/shields Lissandra while making her untargetable.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; magic penetration items amplify her burst damage.
- tip: Maintain distance from W range and dodge Q to avoid her CC chain.

lux.notes:
- Passive (Illumination): Next attack detonates energy for bonus magic damage
- Q (Light Binding): Sphere binds and damages up to two enemies
- W (Prismatic Barrier): Shield friendlies by bending light around them
- E (Lucent Singularity): Anomaly slows enemies; detonate for area damage
- R (Final Spark): Beam damages all targets, triggers passive, refreshes debuff
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; ability haste items amplify threat
- tip: Respect her range; dodge light binding and avoid grouped formations

malphite.notes:
- passive (Granite Shield): Absorbs 10% max health damage, recharges after few seconds without hits
- Q (Seismic Shard): Sends earth shard dealing damage and stealing enemy movement speed for 3s
- W (Thunderclap): Next attacks create sonic boom aftershocks in front for few seconds
- E (Ground Slam): Slams ground sending shockwave, deals magic damage based on armor, reduces attack speed
- R (Unstoppable Force): Launches at high speed to location, damages and knocks up enemies
- spike: Level 6 ultimate available; becomes stronger with armor stacking items
- tip: Spread out to avoid clustered ultimate knock-up and chain crowd control

malzahar.notes:
- Passive (Void Shift): Grants damage reduction and crowd control immunity when untouched.
- Q (Call of the Void): Opens portals that fire projectiles, silencing hit champions.
- W (Void Swarm): Summons Voidlings to attack enemies nearby.
- E (Malefic Visions): Deals damage over time; refreshes when Malzahar casts spells.
- R (Nether Grasp): Channels suppression and damage in target zone.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate enables all-in combos; sustained damage items scale hard.
- tip: Stay mobile and outside E range; cleanse suppression or dodge R channel.

maokai.notes:
- Passive (Sap Magic): Basic attacks heal and deal bonus damage, cooldown reduced by spells/enemy spells
- Q (Bramble Smash): Shockwave knocks back nearby enemies, deals magic damage, slows them
- W (Twisted Advance): Dash to target while untargetable, root on arrival
- E (Sapling Toss): Place sapling guard in area, stronger effect in brush
- R (Nature's Grasp): Wall of brambles advances forward, damages and roots enemies hit
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; increases with tank items (Hollow Radiance, Abyssal)
- tip: Stay away from walls and brush to avoid root chain combos

masteryi.notes:
- passive (Double Strike): Every few consecutive basic attacks, Master Yi strikes twice.
- Q (Alpha Strike): Teleport across battlefield, deal physical damage to units in path, become untargetable.
- W (Meditate): Restore health and take reduced damage while channeling through focus.
- E (Wuju Style): Gain bonus true damage on basic attacks.
- R (Highlander): Increase move speed and attack speed, ignore slows, extend duration on kills.
- spike: Level 6 with Highlander; critical item spike with attack speed items.
- tip: Stay grouped and use hard crowd control to lock him down early.

mel.notes:
- passive (Searing Brilliance): Gain three bonus projectiles per ability, max nine; apply infinite Overwhelm stacks on damage
- Q (Radiant Barrage): Volley of projectiles dealing magic damage; cooldown reduced on champion hit
- W (Rebuttal): Nova destroys projectiles, retaliates with missiles; shields and speeds up allies
- E (Solar Snare): Orb roots center, slows and damages surrounding enemies over time
- R (Golden Eclipse): Strike all Overwhelm-marked enemies regardless of distance; damage scales with stack count
- spike: Level six with ultimate; power spike at ability haste items
- tip: Stay behind minions to block projectiles and prevent Overwhelm stack application

milio.notes:
- Passive (Fired Up!): Enchant allies on touch; next damage deals burst and burn
- Q (Ultra Mega Fire Kick): Kick ball that knocks back, launches up, damages and slows area
- W (Cozy Campfire): Create healing zone increasing ally attack range; follows nearest ally
- E (Warm Hugs): Toss shield to ally for movement speed; two charges available
- R (Breath of Life): Heal allies in range and remove crowd control effects
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; stronger with enchantment items and healing
- tip: Separate from allies to reduce Campfire value and burst damage

missfortune.notes:
- passive (Love Tap): Bonus physical damage on basic attacks against new targets
- Q (Double Up): Fire bullet through enemy, damaging target and one behind them
- W (Strut): Gain movespeed when untouched; activate for attack speed; Love Tap reduces cooldown
- E (Make It Rain): Reveal area with bullets, dealing damage waves and slowing enemies
- R (Bullet Time): Channel barrage cone dealing massive damage; waves can critically strike
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with attack speed and crit items
- tip: Avoid clustering behind minions; position sideways to dodge Double Up and ultimate

morgana.notes:
- passive (Soul Siphon): Drains enemy spirit, healing on champion/large minion damage
- Q (Dark Binding): Roots enemy in place, dealing magic damage
- W (Tormented Shadow): Damages enemies in area over time, scales with low health
- E (Black Shield): Shields ally, absorbs magic damage and disabling effects
- R (Soul Shackles): Hovers, chains nearby enemies, gains movement speed
- spike: Level 6 ultimate unlocked; second spike at ability power items
- tip: Dodge Q binding; position behind minions to block root

nami.notes:
- passive (Surging Tides): Ability hits grant allied champions movement speed buff
- Q (Aqua Prison): Sends bubble to area, stuns and damages enemies hit
- W (Ebb and Flow): Water bounces between allies and enemies, heals and damages
- E (Tidecaller's Blessing): Empowers ally with bonus magic damage and slow on attacks
- R (Tidal Wave): Massive wave knocks up, slows, damages enemies; doubles passive buff
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with support item completion
- tip: Spread out to reduce Ebb and Flow bounce effectiveness

nasus.notes:
- passive (Soul Eater): Grants bonus Life Steal against champions
- Q (Siphoning Strike): Deals damage; permanently stacks if it kills
- W (Wither): Slows Move Speed and Attack Speed over time
- E (Spirit Fire): Deals damage and reduces Armor in area
- R (Fury of the Sands): Gains Health, Range, Armor; damages nearby
- spike: Level 6 Ultimate and three-item power spike
- tip: Kite backwards and avoid extended fights near minions

naafiri.notes:
- passive (We Are More): Spawns packmates that attack targets of her attacks and abilities
- Q (Darkin Daggers): Hurl daggers applying bleed or bonus damage; packmates leap to first hit
- W (The Call of the Pack): Become untargetable, empower pack, spawn packmates, gain movespeed and attack damage
- E (Eviscerate): Dash damaging area, recall packmates, fully heal them
- R (Hounds' Pursuit): Dash at champion with pack dealing damage; recast grants shield after takedown
- spike: Level six ultimate and early lethality items enable burst combo
- tip: Maintain distance and group; kite away from her packmates' engagement range

neeko.notes:
- Passive (Inherent Glamour): Disguise as ally champions or map units for deception.
- Q (Blooming Burst): Throw seed dealing magic damage, blooms again on champion hit.
- W (Shapesplitter): Every third attack deals bonus magic damage and speeds Neeko up.
- E (Tangle-Barbs): Sling root that grows larger and stuns longer after champion hit.
- R (Pop Blossom): Leap into air knocking up nearby enemies, stun on landing.
- spike: Level 6 when ultimate available; stronger with ability power items.
- tip: Watch for disguised Neeko near teammates and avoid grouping tightly.

nidalee.notes:
- passive (Prowl): Move speed boost in brush, stronger toward nearby enemy champions
- Q (Javelin Toss / Takedown): Ranged poke or execute; damage scales with distance
- W (Bushwhack / Pounce): Trap reveals enemies or mobile gap-closer with area damage
- E (Primal Surge / Swipe): Heal and attack speed buff or directional claw damage
- R (Aspect Of The Cougar): Transform into cougar, gaining new ability effects
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with ability haste items
- tip: Stay out of brush and maintain distance from potential engage range

nocturne.notes:
- passive (Umbra Blades): Periodic bonus damage AoE attack heals Nocturne; auto attacks reduce cooldown
- Q (Duskbringer): Shadow blade deals damage, creates trail granting movespeed, AD, and unit-phasing
- W (Shroud of Darkness): Passively grants attack speed; actively blocks incoming CC
- E (Unspeakable Horror): Plants fear debuff; fears target if they stay in range
- R (Paranoia): Blind all enemies, remove ward vision, dash to nearby champion
- spike: Level 6 ultimate enables roaming ganks; armor penetration items amplify damage
- tip: Ward river and stay grouped; group vision denies his ultimate engage

nunuwillump.notes:
- passive (Call of the Freljord): Boosts ally attack/move speed; Willump's attacks damage nearby enemies
- Q (Consume): Bite minion/monster/champion for damage and healing
- W (Biggest Snowball Ever!): Roll growing snowball that damages and knocks up enemies
- E (Snowball Barrage): Throw snowballs damaging enemies; roots hit champions/large monsters
- R (Absolute Zero): Create blizzard slowing enemies; massive damage at end
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with cooldown reduction items
- tip: Spread out to dodge Snowball Barrage and avoid chain roots

olaf.notes:
- passive (Berserker Rage): Gains attack speed and lifesteal scaling with missing health
- Q (Undertow): Throw axe dealing damage, reducing armor/movespeed; cooldown resets on pickup
- W (Tough It Out): Increase attack speed and gain a shield
- E (Reckless Swing): Deal true damage to target and self; refund if kill
- R (Ragnarok): Passively gain armor/magic resist; activate for disable immunity while attacking
- spike: Level 6 ultimate enables extended teamfight presence and disable evasion
- tip: Kite away and avoid close combat; use crowd control before activation

orianna.notes:
- passive (Clockwork Windup): attacks deal extra magic damage, stacking higher per target hit
- Q (Command: Attack): ball fires to location, damages enemies hit, stays at endpoint
- W (Command: Dissonance): ball pulses damage around it, creates ally speed/enemy slow field
- E (Command: Protect): ball shields ally champion, damages enemies it passes through
- R (Command: Shockwave): ball shockwaves nearby enemies toward it after delay, deals damage
- spike: level 6 with ultimate; power item spikes at ability haste thresholds
- tip: spread formation to minimize shockwave impact and maximize distance from ball

ornn.notes:
- passive (Living Forge): Bonus armor and magic resist; forge items anywhere and create masterwork upgrades.
- Q (Volcanic Rupture): Slam ground, fissure damages and slows; pillar forms at end.
- W (Bellows Breath): Advance with fire breath; final flame applies Brittle debuff.
- E (Searing Charge): Charge through enemies for damage; terrain collision knocks up nearby foes.
- R (Call of the Forge God): Summon elemental traveling toward you, damages and slows enemies hit.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate enables engage; armor/magic resist items amplify tankiness dramatically.
- tip: Stay away from walls to avoid E knockup chain combos.

pyke.notes:
- passive (Gift of the Drowned Ones): regenerate damage taken while hidden; gain AD instead of max HP
- Q (Bone Skewer): stab forward or pull enemy toward you
- W (Ghostwater Dive): enter camouflage and move faster; speed decays over time
- E (Phantom Undertow): dash and leave phantom that stuns enemies on return
- R (Death From Below): execute low health enemies; grants extra gold to allies
- spike: level 6 with ultimate; lethality items amplify burst threat
- tip: stay grouped and maintain distance from walls to prevent execution

qiyana.notes:
- passive (Royal Privilege): First attack or ability per enemy deals bonus damage
- Q (Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal): Swings weapon, bonus effect based on element
- W (Terrashape): Dash and enchant weapon; attacks deal bonus damage while active
- E (Audacity): Dash to enemy, dealing damage
- R (Supreme Display of Talent): Shockwave detonates elements, stuns and damages nearby enemies
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; early lethality items strengthen burst
- tip: Stay grouped and itemize armor; avoid isolated positioning near terrain

quinn.notes:
- Passive (Harrier): Valor marks enemies; bonus damage on next basic attack
- Q (Blinding Assault): Mark enemy, reduce vision, damage area around target
- W (Heightened Senses): Gain attack and move speed after hitting Harrier; reveal area
- E (Vault): Dash to enemy, damage, slow, interrupt, leap away
- R (Behind Enemy Lines): Flight boost then Skystrike; damage nearby and mark champions
- spike: Level 6 ultimate unlocked; mid-game with attack speed items
- tip: Stay grouped; avoid isolated positions where Vault combo secures kills

rakan.notes:
- passive (Fey Feathers): Periodically gains a shield, refreshing on ability use
- Q (Gleaming Quill): Flings feather dealing magic damage; heals allies on champion hit
- W (Grand Entrance): Dashes to location, knocking up nearby enemies on arrival
- E (Battle Dance): Flies to ally granting shield; free re-cast for short duration
- R (The Quickness): Gains move speed, charms and damages enemies touched
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with support item completion
- tip: Stay grouped and respect his engage range; build Mikael's or Quicksilver

rammus.notes:
- Passive (Spiked Shell): Gains Attack Damage scaling with Armor and Magic Resistance.
- Q (Powerball): Accelerates in ball form, dealing damage and slowing on impact.
- W (Defensive Ball Curl): Increases Armor and Magic Resistance, returns damage to attackers.
- E (Frenzying Taunt): Taunts enemy champion or monster into attacking him recklessly.
- R (Soaring Slam): Slams target area with magic damage and slow; knocks up if from Powerball.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with Armor stacking items.
- tip: Avoid melee engagement; kite at range and burst before taunt lands.

rell.notes:
- Passive (Break the Mold): Attacks and abilities deal bonus magic damage and steal defenses.
- Q (Shattering Strike): Deal magic damage in a line, break shields, stun targets.
- W (Ferromancy: Crash Down): Dismount, knock up enemies, gain shield and defensive stats, move slower.
- E (Full Tilt): Gain out-of-combat speed; active gives ramping speed to ally, next attack explodes.
- R (Magnet Storm): Pull nearby enemies toward you, then continuously drag them closer.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; first armor item spike.
- tip: Stay spread and away from walls to minimize ultimate pull effectiveness.

reksai.notes:
- passive (Fury of the Xer'Sai): Generate Fury via attacks/abilities; consume while burrowed to heal
- Q (Queen's Wrath / Prey Seeker): Next 3 attacks bonus damage; burrowed launches revealing void burst
- W (Burrow / Un-burrow): Burrow for new abilities, speed, reduced vision; Unburrow knocks up nearby
- E (Furious Bite / Tunnel): Bite deals physical or true damage at max Fury; burrowed creates tunnel
- R (Void Rush): Passively mark damaged targets; activate to dash untargetable at marked enemy
- spike: Level 6 Ultimate unlocked; mid-game with bruiser items amplifies burst damage
- tip: Ward tunnels to deny map control; avoid standing near marked allies during Ultimate

rengar.notes:
- passive (Unseen Predator): leap from brush; generate Ferocity per ability; empower next ability at max
- Q (Savagery): bonus damage on next attack; empowered grants increased damage and attack speed
- W (Battle Roar): damage and heal from recent damage taken; empowered breaks crowd control
- E (Bola Strike): slow target; empowered roots target instead
- R (Thrill of the Hunt): camouflage self and reveal nearest enemy champion in large radius
- spike: level 6 ultimate enables roaming ganks; lethality items amplify burst damage significantly
- tip: stay grouped and avoid brush to deny leap; buy vision control

ryze.notes:
- passive (Arcane Mastery): Extra spell damage from bonus mana, more max mana from ability power
- Q (Overload): Other abilities reset cooldown and charge runes; 2 runes grants move speed burst
- W (Rune Prison): Damage and slow target; root if target has Flux instead
- E (Spell Flux): Damage enemy and debuff nearby enemies; Ryze spells have bonus effects on debuffed targets
- R (Realm Warp): Overload deals extra damage to Flux targets; cast creates ally teleport portal
- spike: Level 9 and when building mana items; becomes increasingly dangerous throughout mid-game
- tip: Maintain distance and dodge E to prevent Flux debuff chain reactions

rumble.notes:
- passive (Junkyard Titan): Spellcasting grants Heat; Danger Zone activates at 50% Heat, buffing abilities
- Q (Flamespitter): Cone magic damage over 3 seconds; increased damage in Danger Zone
- W (Scrap Shield): Shield and speed burst; shield strength and speed increased in Danger Zone
- E (Electro Harpoon): Magic damage, slow, Magic Resist reduction; carries 2 harpoons; enhanced in Danger Zone
- R (The Equalizer): Rocket wall damages and slows enemies in large area
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and mid-game AP item power spikes
- tip: Keep distance to dodge Flamespitter cone and avoid Equalizer wall damage

sejuani.notes:
- passive (Fury of the North): Gain Armor/Magic Resist and slow immunity out of combat.
- Q (Arctic Assault): Charge forward, knock enemies airborne, stop at champion.
- W (Winter's Wrath): Swing twice, damage, slow, and stack Frost on enemies.
- E (Permafrost): Stun enemy champion with maximum Frost stacks.
- R (Glacial Prison): Throw bola, freeze and stun first champion, slow others.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and early tank item completion.
- tip: Space away from her mace range; don't clump near walls.

seraphine.notes:
- Passive (Stage Presence): Every third spell casts twice; bonus damage and range on next attack near allies
- Q (High Note): Deals damage in an area
- W (Surround Sound): Shields and hastes allies; heals if already shielded
- E (Beat Drop): Deals damage and slows enemies in a line
- R (Encore): Damages and charms enemies; range refreshes per champion hit
- spike: Level 6 with Encore; stronger with utility and AP items
- tip: Spread out to limit Encore chain; interrupt her channeling when possible

shen.notes:
- passive (Ki Barrier): Spell cast grants shield; cooldown reduced by affecting champions
- Q (Twilight Assault): Recall blade to damage; empowered vs champions, slows enemies fleeing
- W (Spirit's Refuge): Block attacks on Shen and nearby allies at blade location
- E (Shadow Dash): Dash in direction, taunting enemies caught in path
- R (Stand United): Shield ally champion, then teleport to their location
- spike: Level 6 with Stand United; triforce/health items spike mid-game
- tip: Spread out to minimize taunt chain; dodge E or stay distant

singed.notes:
- passive (Noxious Slipstream): Gain Move Speed burst when passing nearby champions
- Q (Poison Trail): Leave damaging poison trail behind you while moving
- W (Mega Adhesive): Throw ground vial slowing and grounding enemies walking it
- E (Fling): Damage and fling target enemy behind you, roots if landed in adhesive
- R (Insanity Potion): Gain combat stats, Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate, or after Rylai's acquisition
- tip: Maintain distance and kite away; don't let him chase through poison

shyvana.notes:
- passive (Scalemail): Takedowns grant stacks, improving armor and magic resist
- Q (Emberstrike): Next attack hits target and area, recastable, Dragon Form adds third cast
- W (Inferno Aegis): Grants shield and movespeed, then detonates; Dragon Form heals on champion hit
- E (Molten Burst): Fireball explodes on large targets, slows; Dragon Form pierces and leaves fire trail
- R (Dragon's Descent): Transform into dragon, leap forward, enemies flee; empowers all basic abilities
- spike: Level 6 Dragon Form unlock; scales with tank item completion
- tip: Stay spread to minimize W detonation damage and dodge E skillshots

sion.notes:
- passive (Glory in Death): Reanimates after death with decaying health, rapid attacks heal and bonus damage
- Q (Decimating Smash): Charges swing dealing damage; full charge knocks up and stuns hit enemies
- W (Soul Furnace): Shields self, reactivate for magic damage; gains max health per enemy kill
- E (Roar of the Slayer): Short shockwave damages, slows, and reduces armor of first enemy hit
- R (Unstoppable Onslaught): Charges direction with ramping speed; collision deals damage and knockup based on distance
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; dangerous with armor items and health scaling
- tip: Maintain distance and dodge his Q charge; group when he ults to minimize knockup impact

skarner.notes:
- Passive (Threads of Vibration): Attacks apply Quaking stacks; max stacks deal max Health magic damage
- Q (Shattered Earth): Boulder empowers attacks or throws as projectile
- W (Seismic Bastion): Gain shield, earthquake damages and slows enemies
- E (Ixtal's Impact): Charge through terrain, slam champions into walls for stun
- R (Impale): Suppress enemies and drag them as you move
- spike: Level 6 with Impale; stronger with tank items
- tip: Maintain distance and position near terrain to escape Impale drag

sivir.notes:
- passive (Fleet of Foot): Sivir gains move speed when attacking enemy champions
- Q (Boomerang Blade): Hurls crossblade dealing damage outbound and returning
- W (Ricochet): Next attacks gain speed and bounce to nearby enemies
- E (Spell Shield): Blocks one enemy ability, heals and grants move speed
- R (On The Hunt): Grants allies move speed; Sivir's attacks reduce spell cooldowns
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; critical after attack speed item completion
- tip: Stay spread out to minimize Ricochet bounces between grouped targets

smolder.notes:
- passive (Dragon Practice): Stacks increase basic ability damage; gained from ability hits and kills
- Q (Super Scorcher Breath): Targeted fire damage scaling with Dragon Practice stacks
- W (Achooo!): Explosive sneeze projectile dealing damage on champion hit
- E (Flap, Flap, Flap): Aerial bombardment targeting lowest health enemy, ignoring terrain
- R (MMOOOMMMM!): Mom breathes fire from above, extra damage and slow center
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and mid-game AD/crit items power spike
- tip: Spread formation to deny E targeting and reduce R effectiveness

soraka.notes:
- Passive (Salvation): Run faster toward nearby low-health allies
- Q (Starcall): Star falls, damages and slows; heals on champion hit
- W (Astral Infusion): Sacrifice own health to heal another ally
- E (Equinox): Zone silences enemies; roots them when expiring
- R (Wish): Instantly heal self and all allied champions
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; healing item purchases
- tip: Engage enemies before Soraka reaches teammates; pressure isolated targets

sona.notes:
- passive (Power Chord: Accelerando): Gains ability haste; beyond cap, reduces ultimate cooldown
- Q (Hymn of Valor): Sends sound bolts dealing magic damage to two enemies
- W (Aria of Perseverance): Heals Sona and ally; grants shield aura to nearby allies
- E (Song of Celerity): Grants nearby allies movement speed; extends speed aura to zone
- R (Crescendo): Stuns and forces enemy champions to dance, dealing magic damage
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; significant power with healing item completion
- tip: Stay outside her aura range to minimize support value and healing

swain.notes:
- passive (Ravenous Flock): Ravens collect Soul Fragments, healing and permanently increasing maximum health
- Q (Death's Hand): Unleash piercing bolts; each bolt hit increases damage taken by target
- W (Vision of Empire): Demon eye deals damage, slows, reveals champions, grants Swain Soul Fragment
- E (Nevermove): Launch wave that returns, roots hit enemies; pull rooted champions closer
- R (Demonic Ascension): Transform into demon, drain nearby enemies; cast Demonflare for area slow
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with health scaling items spike
- tip: Stay outside ultimate range and dodge E; build grievous wounds early

tahmkench.notes:
- passive (An Acquired Taste): Extra damage scales with health; three stacks enable Devour on champions
- Q (Tongue Lash): Lash applies stack, slows first target, heals on champion hit
- W (Abyssal Dive): Dive to location, damage and knockup enemies in area
- E (Thick Skin): Store damage out-of-combat, convert stored damage to temporary shield active
- R (Devour): Eat enemy champion for damage or ally for shield
- spike: Level six with ultimate; stronger with tank/health items
- tip: Maintain distance and avoid grouping to prevent multi-target Abyssal Dive engagement

taliyah.notes:
- Passive (Rock Surfing): Gain movement speed near walls
- Q (Threaded Volley): Throw rocks freely while moving, creates worked ground
- W (Seismic Shove): Erupt ground and knock enemies in chosen direction
- E (Unraveled Earth): Create slowing minefield that stuns dashing enemies through it
- R (Weaver's Wall): Create long wall and surf it for mobility
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; AP items at two items
- tip: Avoid dashing through Unraveled Earth; stay away from walls

talon.notes:
- passive (Blade's End): Wounds stack to 3, triggering bleed on champions
- Q (Noxian Diplomacy): Melee stab crits; ranged triggers leap-stab combo
- W (Rake): Daggers pass through enemies twice, return slower and harder
- E (Assassin's Path): Vault terrain with low cooldown; terrain resets slowly
- R (Shadow Assault): Invisible ring of blades converges on emergence
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; lethality items amplify burst
- tip: Stay grouped and ward jungle to prevent flank assassination

taric.notes:
- passive (Bravado): Empowers next 2 attacks with bonus damage, cooldown reduction, fast succession
- Q (Starlight's Touch): Heals nearby allies; Bravado attacks grant healing charges
- W (Bastion): Grants armor to self and shielded ally; duplicates spells on ally
- E (Dazzle): Delays then stuns enemies in a beam
- R (Cosmic Radiance): Delays then grants invulnerability to nearby allies
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and armor itemization make him unkillable
- tip: Spread out to minimize ultimate coverage and spell duplication from Bastion

thresh.notes:
- passive (Damnation): Harvest enemy souls nearby for permanent Armor and Ability Power stacks
- Q (Death Sentence): Chain enemy, pull toward you; recast pulls you to enemy
- W (Dark Passage): Throw lantern shielding allies; allies click lantern to dash to you
- E (Flay): Attacks wind up for more damage; activate sweeps chain, knocking enemies
- R (The Box): Prison walls slow and damage enemies that break through them
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with Armor/Magic Resist items
- tip: Stay away from walls and teammates to minimize Box trap effectiveness

trundle.notes:
- passive (King's Tribute): Heal for percent of nearby enemy unit deaths' max Health
- Q (Chomp): Bite opponent, deal damage, slow briefly, steal Attack Damage
- W (Frozen Domain): Gain Attack Speed, Move Speed, increased healing in domain
- E (Pillar of Ice): Create impassable terrain, slow nearby enemies
- R (Subjugate): Steal Health/Armor/Magic Resistance; amount doubles over 4 seconds
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; first armor item spike
- tip: Kite away from Frozen Domain; position far from Pillar

tristana.notes:
- passive (Draw a Bead): Attack range increases with each level up, scaling up to 669 range
- Q (Rapid Fire): Gain attack speed for short duration, fire rapidly at current target
- W (Rocket Jump): Jump to location, deal damage, slow enemies at landing zone briefly
- E (Explosive Charge): Kill units to burst shrapnel around them; activate to bomb target enemy
- R (Buster Shot): Fire massive cannonball dealing magic damage and knocking target backward significantly
- spike: Level 6 ultimate unlock; crit itemization completion gives massive damage spike
- tip: Respect her range; position behind minions and dodge Rocket Jump engage attempts

tryndamere.notes:
- passive (Battle Fury): Gains Fury per attack/crit/kill; increases crit chance, consumable by Bloodlust
- Q (Bloodlust): Consume Fury to heal; more damage when wounded
- W (Mocking Shout): Reduce nearby champions' AD; slow enemies facing away
- E (Spinning Slash): Slash toward target, damage enemies in path
- R (Undying Rage): Become unkillable for duration, no matter health
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; strong at crit item breakpoints
- tip: Kite away and avoid extended fights during Undying Rage duration

twistedfate.notes:
- Passive (Loaded Dice): Killing units grants 1-6 bonus gold randomly.
- Q (Wild Cards): Throws three cards dealing damage through enemies.
- W (Pick a Card): Next attack gains bonus effect from card choice.
- E (Stacked Deck): Every fourth attack deals bonus damage, increases attack speed.
- R (Destiny): Reveals all enemies, teleports to target location in 1.5s.
- spike: Level 6 Destiny enables global map pressure and picks.
- tip: Ward map edges; avoid predictable positioning when Destiny active.

twitch.notes:
- passive (Deadly Venom): basic attacks poison enemies, dealing true damage per second
- Q (Ambush): stealth and move speed; attack speed on exit; resets on champion kill

urgot.notes:

vayne.notes:

varus.notes:
- passive (Living Vengeance): Kill or assist grants temporary Attack Damage and Ability Power bonus.

veigar.notes:
- passive (Phenomenal Evil Power): Permanently gain AP from champion hits and takedowns
- Q (Baleful Strike): Bolt damages first two enemies; killed units grant permanent AP

vi.notes:
- passive (Blast Shield): Charges shield over time, activates on ability hit
- Q (Vault Breaker): Charges forward with knockback punch, applies Denting Blows stacks

viego.notes:
- passive (Sovereign's Domination): Slay enemies to possess their body, heal, gain abilities/items
- Q (Blade of the Ruined King): Bonus current health damage on-hit, double strikes after abilities

- E (Harrowed Path): Hide in terrain mist, gain camouflage, movespeed, attack speed
- R (Heartbreaker): Teleport nearby, execute enemy champion, shockwave knocks away their allies

vladimir.notes:
- passive (Crimson Pact): Bonus health grants AP; AP grants health. No stack limit.
- Q (Transfusion): Steal life from enemy; full resource triggers empowered damage and healing.
- W (Sanguine Pool): Untargetable two seconds; slow enemies; siphon their health.
- E (Tides of Blood): Pay health to charge reservoir; release for area damage.
- R (Hemoplague): Infect area; enemies take more damage; later deals magic damage, heals Vladimir.

wukong.notes:
- passive (Stone Skin): stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters
- Q (Crushing Blow): next attack gains range, bonus damage, and reduces target armor
- W (Warrior Trickster): become invisible, dash away, leave clone that attacks nearby enemies
- E (Nimbus Strike): dash to enemy, send images attacking nearby enemies for damage
- R (Cyclone): spin staff for movespeed, damage enemies, and knock them up repeatedly

- tip: space away from his dash range and avoid clumping near clone

xayah.notes:
- passive (Clean Cuts): Next basic attacks hit all targets in path, leave Feather
- Q (Double Daggers): Throw two daggers dealing damage, drop Feathers for recall
- W (Deadly Plumage): Storm of blades boost Attack Speed, damage, Move Speed vs champions
- E (Bladecaller): Recall all Feathers, deal damage and root enemies hit
- R (Featherstorm): Leap untargetable, throw dagger fan, drop Feathers for recall
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and mid-game Attack Speed item completion
- tip: Stay behind minions to avoid Feather volleys and root chains

xerath.notes:
- passive (Mana Surge): Basic attacks restore mana; cooldown resets on kills
- Q (Arcanopulse): Long-range beam dealing magic damage to all hit targets
- W (Eye of Destruction): Area barrage slowing enemies; center hits deal extra damage
- E (Shocking Orb): Single-target magic damage and stun
- R (Rite of the Arcane): Immobilize to unleash multiple long-range barrages
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with ability haste items
- tip: Stay behind minions and avoid predictable positioning near lane walls

yasuo.notes:
- passive (Way of the Wanderer): Critical Strike Chance increased; moving builds shield that triggers on champion/monster damage
- Q (Steel Tempest): Thrust forward damaging enemies in line; 2 stacks fires knockup whirlwind
- W (Wind Wall): Creates moving wall blocking all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds
- E (Sweeping Blade): Dash through enemy dealing magic damage; stacking damage up to max; cooldown per enemy

yunara.notes:
- Passive (Vow of the First Lands): Critical Strikes deal bonus magic damage
- Q (Cultivation of Spirit): Gain Attack Speed, On-Hit damage, attacks spread nearby

- E (Kanmei's Steps | Untouchable Shadow): Gain Move Speed and Ghosted; transcendent dashes instead
- R (Transcend One's Self): Upgrade basic abilities into stronger transcendent versions temporarily
- spike: Level 6 unlocks upgraded abilities; Attack Speed items amplify all threats
- tip: Maintain distance and group tightly to minimize her Attack Speed spread

yone.notes:
- Passive (Way of the Hunter): Every second attack deals magic damage; increased critical strike chance
- Q (Mortal Steel): Thrust forward damaging enemies in line; 2 stacks dash forward knocking airborne

- E (Soul Unbound): Spirit leaves body gaining move speed; return repeats portion damage as spirit
- R (Fate Sealed): Blink behind last champion, slash pulls all enemies toward Yone

- Tip: Respect his E range; avoid grouping when he has ultimate available

yuumi.notes:
- passive (Feline Friendship): Periodically heals Yuumi and next attached ally after striking champions
- Q (Prowling Projectile): Fires slow missile; bonus damage and slow if delayed 1.35+ seconds
- W (You and Me!): Dashes to ally, untargetable except towers, grants healing and shield power

zaahen.notes:
- passive (Cultivation of War): Attacks grant Determination stacks, bonus AD per stack, revives when full

- R (Grim Deliverance): Rise and stab down, damage and heal based on damage dealt

zac.notes:
- passive (Cell Division): Shed chunks on ability hits; reabsorb for health or revive as bloblets.

zeri.notes:

zilean.notes:
- passive (Time In A Bottle): Grant stored experience to allies; receive equal experience back

- tip: Spread out to avoid stacked bombs; focus Zilean before teamfights start

ziggs.notes:
- passive (Short Fuse): Next basic attack bonus magic damage; cooldown reduced by ability use
- Q (Bouncing Bomb): Throw bouncing bomb dealing magic damage to enemies hit
- W (Satchel Charge): Detonate explosive knockback; Ziggs knocked away but takes no damage

- tip: Respect his range and stay behind minions to dodge Q bounces

zoe.notes:
- passive (More Sparkles!): Next basic attack after spell deals bonus magic damage
- Q (Paddle Star!): Fire redirectable missile; damage increases with flight distance
- W (Spell Thief): Pickup enemy summoner/item casts; gain 3 homing missiles per cast
- E (Sleepy Trouble Bubble): Sleep target, reduce magic resist, double first damage taken
- R (Portal Jump): Blink away then back after 1 second
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; power spikes with AP items
- tip: Maintain distance and block skillshots; dodge E to prevent doubled damage

zyra.notes:
- passive (Garden of Thorns): Seeds spawn around Zyra; spawn rate increases with level

- W (Rampant Growth): Plant seed lasting 60 seconds; can store multiple; enemy kills reduce cooldown

- tip: Stay away from seeds; dodge E root by moving sideways immediately

jax.notes:
- Passive (Relentless Assault): Consecutive basic attacks grant stacking Attack Speed with no cap.

- W (Empower): Next attack deals bonus damage after charging weapon with energy.

aurelionsol.notes:

annie.notes:

- tip: Maintain distance and dodge her cone; block stuns with distance

akali.notes:
- passive (Assassin's Mark): Exiting marked ring empowers next attack with bonus range, damage

belveth.notes:

blitzcrank.notes:

darius.notes:

nilah.notes:

poppy.notes:

sett.notes:

- tip: Stand away from teammates to minimize Chain Lash multi-hit damage

syndra.notes:
- passive (Transcendent): Collect Splinters; upgrade abilities and gain Dark Sphere charges.
- Q (Dark Sphere): Conjure sphere dealing magic damage; sphere persists on field.
- W (Force of Will): Pick up and throw sphere or minion; slow enemies.
- E (Scatter the Weak): Knock back enemies and spheres; stun if hit by sphere.
- R (Unleashed Power): Bombard enemy champion with all Dark Spheres simultaneously.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with ability power items.
- tip: Respect her range; dodge Dark Spheres and maintain distance.

udyr.notes:
- passive (Bridge Between): Swap stances; recast for ultimate benefits. Gain attack speed after ability use.
- Q (Wilding Claw): Attack speed and bonus physical damage on next two attacks.
- W (Iron Mantle): Shield and healing on next two attacks per cast.
- E (Blazing Stampede): Movement speed; first attack stuns each target.
- R (Wingborne Storm): Glacial storm damages and slows nearby enemies.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger with attack speed items.
- tip: Maintain distance and interrupt his engage patterns with crowd control.

vex.notes:
- passive (Doom 'n Gloom): Periodically empowers next ability to fear and interrupt dashes
- Q (Mistral Bolt): Launch accelerating missile dealing damage
- W (Personal Space): Gain shield, damage nearby enemies
- E (Looming Darkness): Summon slow zone applying Gloom debuff
- R (Shadow Surge): Mark enemy, recast to dash and damage
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; stronger at ability haste items
- tip: Avoid dash attempts when Doom 'n Gloom is active

viktor.notes:
- passive (Glorious Evolution): Kills grant Hex Fragments; 100 fragments permanently augment one ability
- Q (Siphon Power): Blast enemy for damage, shield self, empower next auto attack
- W (Gravity Field): Conjure field slowing enemies; extended duration stuns them
- E (Hextech Ray): Fire line damage; augment adds explosion after ray passes
- R (Arcane Storm): Conjure redirectable storm dealing periodic damage and interrupting channels
- spike: Reaches power around level 9 with augmented E ability
- tip: Stay outside Gravity Field range and kite backward when engaged

volibear.notes:
- passive (The Relentless Storm): Attacks grant attack speed, eventually dealing bonus magic damage nearby
- Q (Thundering Smash): Gains speed toward enemies, stuns and damages first target hit
- W (Frenzied Maul): Damages enemy and marks; recast deals bonus damage and heals
- E (Sky Splitter): Summons lightning bolt, slows enemies, shields Volibear if in radius
- R (Stormbringer): Leaps to location, slows and damages enemies, disables nearby towers
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; dangerous with attack speed and health items
- tip: Maintain distance and kite; build grievous wounds to reduce his healing

warwick.notes:
- passive (Eternal Hunger): bonus magic damage on attacks; heals below 50% health, triples below 25%
- Q (Jaws of the Beast): lunge bite dealing max health damage, heals for damage dealt
- W (Blood Hunt): move speed and attack speed toward low-health enemies, triples below 25%
- E (Primal Howl): damage reduction then fear effect, reactivatable
- R (Infinite Duress): leap suppress first champion hit for 1.5 seconds
- spike: level 6 ultimate available; trinity force or marakana spike
- tip: stay above 50% health and group to prevent isolated target engagement

xinzhao.notes:
- Passive (Determination): Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.
- Q (Three Talon Strike): Next 3 attacks gain damage; third attack knocks enemy airborne.
- W (Wind Becomes Lightning): Slash and thrust that slow enemies and mark them Challenged.
- E (Audacious Charge): Charge enemy for Attack Speed, damage nearby foes, extended range on Challenged.
- R (Crescent Guard): Passively challenge recently damaged enemies.
- spike: Level 6 ultimate and trinity force grant significant dueling power.
- tip: Maintain distance; dodge his charge by positioning behind minions or terrain.

zed.notes:
- passive (Contempt for the Weak): bonus magic damage to low health targets, cooldown per champion
- Q (Razor Shuriken): zed and shadows throw shurikens hitting all enemies in path
- W (Living Shadow): gain energy when zed and shadows hit same ability; shadow dashes forward
- E (Shadow Slash): zed and shadows slash nearby enemies; shadow slash applies slow
- R (Death Mark): dash untargetable to enemy champion, repeat damage dealt during mark after 3 seconds
- spike: level 6 with ultimate; critical at armor penetration item completion
- tip: stay grouped and maintain distance; buy armor and healing reduction items

yorick.notes:
- Passive (Shepherd of Souls): Yorick spawns Mist Walkers to attack nearby enemies automatically.
- Q (Last Rites): Bonus damage attack that heals; digs grave on champion/large monster hit.
- W (Dark Procession): Summons destructible wall blocking enemy movement at target location.
- E (Mourning Mist): Throws mist reducing armor, damaging, slowing; marks enemies for walker speed.
- R (Eulogy of the Isles): Maiden attacks with Yorick, raises walkers from dead enemies.
- spike: Level 6 when ultimate unlocks; armor penetration items amplify damage.
- tip: Stay away from walls and graves; kite away from maiden.

karma.notes:
- passive (Gathering Fire): Damaging abilities reduce Mantra cooldown by 2 seconds
- Q (Inner Flame): Launch spirit ball exploding on enemy hit for damage
- W (Focused Resolve): Tether enemy for damage and reveal; root if unbroken
- E (Inspire): Shield ally and grant them movement speed buff
- R (Mantra): Empower next ability with bonus effects; available level 1
- spike: Level 6 with Mantra upgrades; Liandry or Shadowflame completion
- tip: Respect W tether range; break it early or kite backward

ambessa.notes:
- Passive (Drakehound's Step): Dash after ability cast, next attack gains range/damage/speed, refunds energy
- Q (Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam): Semicircle sweep dealing bonus damage to enemies hit
- W (Repudiation): Shield, brace, ground slam; increased damage if blocked non-minion damage
- E (Lacerate): Whip around self, damage and slow; Drakehound's Step triggers second strike
- R (Public Execution): Blink to farthest enemy, suppress, slam into ground for stun
- spike: Level 6 ultimate; armor/health items amplify tankiness and initiation threat
- tip: Stay grouped and position away from isolated teammates; kite around walls

velkoz.notes:
- passive (Organic Deconstruction): 3 stacks apply true damage burst to enemy
- Q (Plasma Fission): Shoots plasma bolt that splits on reactivation or hit, slows
- W (Void Rift): Opens rift dealing initial damage, explodes after delay for second burst
- E (Tectonic Disruption): Explodes area knocking up enemies, pushing close ones slightly away
- R (Life Form Disintegration Ray): Channels beam following cursor 2.5s, converts researched stacks to true damage
- spike: Level 5 with Q maxed; lethal with mana and ability haste items
- tip: Stay behind minions to block Q volleys and avoid extended fights

lulu.notes:
- passive (Pix, Faerie Companion): Pix fires homing bolts when Lulu or followed ally attacks enemies.
- Q (Glitterlance): Lulu and Pix fire bolts that damage and heavily slow enemies hit.
- W (Whimsy): Ally gains attack and move speed; enemy becomes helpless critter temporarily.
- E (Help, Pix!): Ally gets shield and Pix follows; enemy takes damage from Pix.
- R (Wild Growth): Enlarge ally, knock up nearby enemies, grant bonus health and slow aura.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; mid-game with support items for durability.
- tip: Spread out to minimize Glitterlance hits and exploit cooldowns aggressively.

shaco.notes:
- passive (Backstab): bonus damage when attacking from behind
- Q (Deceive): invisibility and teleport with empowered first attack
- W (Jack In The Box): hidden box fears and attacks enemies
- E (Two-Shiv Poison): poison slows; throwable with execute bonus
- R (Hallucinate): creates attacking clone; spawns boxes on death
- spike: level 6 with ultimate and early item power
- tip: maintain map awareness and ward to deny flanks

ashe.notes:
- passive (Frost Shot): Attacks slow targets; crits apply stronger slow, no bonus damage
- Q (Ranger's Focus): Build stacks attacking; cast at max for attack speed flurry
- W (Volley): Fires cone of arrows dealing damage and applying Frost Shot
- E (Hawkshot): Send hawk spirit to scout anywhere on map
- R (Enchanted Crystal Arrow): Fire ice missile stunning champion; longer range means longer stun
- spike: Crit item purchases and levels 6, 11 become significantly stronger
- tip: Stay behind minions to avoid Volley and Enchanted Crystal Arrow engage

cassiopeia.notes:
- Passive (Serpentine Grace): Move Speed bonuses increased; stacks infinitely.
- Q (Noxious Blast): Poison blast grants Move Speed on champion hit.
- W (Miasma): Poison clouds slow, ground, and damage enemies.
- E (Twin Fang): Enhanced damage to poisoned targets; heals Cassiopeia.
- R (Petrifying Gaze): Stun facing enemies, slow those turning away.
- spike: Level 6 with ultimate; two-item power spike.
- tip: Avoid standing directly in front; respect grounding effect.

ksante.notes:
- passive (Dauntless Instinct): Marks enemies for increased damage; All Out form amplifies all damage
- Q (Ntofo Strikes): Strikes in line, slows, stacks to two then pulls enemies
- W (Path Maker): Charges with reduced damage taken, dashes to knock back and stun
- E (Footwork): Dashes for shield; ally targeting grants increased range and dual shields
- R (All Out): Knocks enemy through walls, transforms into high-damage low-defense form with healing
- spike: Level six with ultimate; power spikes at bruiser item completion
- tip: Stay away from walls to prevent All Out knockback amplification
